$comment: Single source of truth for Uni's visual language. Base ramps come from the Nocturne design system (_ds/nocturne-*/styles.css); the `uni` block adds the semantic roles the tracker and patcher need, which Nocturne does not have. Never write a hex anywhere else — generate from here. See build-tokens.mjs.

font.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

metrics.$comment: Geometry the tracker projects with. Row height and column widths are load-bearing: they are what the view-model maps nanoticks onto.

base.$comment: Verbatim from Nocturne. Do not edit here; re-extract if the design system changes.

uni.$comment: Semantic roles. Each value is either a base reference (base.*) or a literal rgba — literals only where alpha is needed, because a ramp step cannot express translucency over an arbitrary ground.

surface.$offGridComment: Rows a lane does not have. Lanes share one row axis, so a 4-per-beat lane sits on every third row of a 12-per-beat axis; the rest belong to the triplet and sextuplet lanes. Recessed rather than merely empty, because an empty cell is one you can type into and these are not.

rule.$comment: Track borders are deliberately heavier than intra-track column rules — the review found eight single-column tracks read as one undifferentiated grid when they were the same weight.

clip.$comment: Clips span rows, so rails live OUTSIDE the recycled row band — see tracker.js.

track.$comment: Per-track tint so adjacent tracks read as separate. Eight hues on the Nocturne lightness scale, at 4% over the ground.
